classification.difficultyReason: Interpret grouped counts and derive minimum and maximum possible totals using integer class endpoints.

content.prompt: A student counted the number of cars that passed through an intersection on each cycle of the traffic lights. The results of her investigation are shown in the histogram opposite.

spec.description: Supplied histogram with horizontal gridlines and a horizontal-axis break before 20. Decorative turquoise is mapped to house blue.

children.label: a
children.prompt: For how many cycles did the student record the number of cars passing through the intersection?

children.label: i
children.prompt: fewer than 30 cars pass through the intersection

children.label: ii
children.prompt: at least 35 cars pass through the intersection?

children.label: c
children.prompt: Why is it impossible to determine from the histogram how many cars in total passed through the intersection during the survey period?

answer.short: The exact number of cars in each cycle is unknown.
answer.worked: The histogram gives class frequencies, not the individual car counts. Counts within each class can vary, so their exact total cannot be determined.

children.label: i
children.prompt: the minimum number of cars that could have passed through the intersection during the survey period

answer.short:
$1050$ cars.

Use the smallest integer count in each class.
answer.worked:
The smallest counts in the five classes are $20,25,30,35,40$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Minimum total}&=8\times20+12\times25+10\times30+6\times35+2\times40\\\text{Minimum total}&=1050\end{aligned}$$
The minimum is $1050$ cars.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: the maximum number of cars that could have passed through the intersection in the survey period

answer.short:
$1202$ cars.

Use the largest integer count in each class.
answer.worked:
The largest counts in the five integer classes are $24,29,34,39,44$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Maximum total}&=8\times24+12\times29+10\times34+6\times39+2\times44\\\text{Maximum total}&=1202\end{aligned}$$
The maximum is $1202$ cars.
